info.name: Helpdesk API
info.description:
Support Ticket Management System API.

Setup: set collection variable `adminPassword` (and `baseUrl` if running locally), then run the folders in order with the Collection Runner. Tokens and IDs are saved automatically by test scripts.

request.description: Public. Confirms the API is up.
Public. New accounts are always USER.

item.name: Register - role in body is ignored

request.description: Security check: clients cannot self-assign ADMIN.
Set the collection variable adminPassword first.

item.name: 2. Tickets (User)

request.description: Users only see their own tickets.

request.description: Query params: status, priority, q, sort (created_at|updated_at), order, page, limit (max 50).
404 instead of 403 so ticket IDs cannot be probed.
